messages.historyTooLarge: File exceeds the 7 MiB browser limit.
messages.historyOperationFailed: Archive operation failed. Original files remain recoverable; refresh manually.
messages.historyOperationUnknown: Archive operation outcome unknown. Refresh manually before retrying; no automatic retry.

phrases.Норма 250. Точно не известно; вероятно,: Normal 250. Not known for sure; probably a protection: current limit (25.0 A), voltage/RPM or overload threshold. Do not increase — you may burn the motor or board.

phrases.Как штатный бортовой компьютер: отправля: Like the stock onboard computer: all 7 parameters are sent, the board confirms each (✓). The board stores them and can't report them back — the last values written from here are shown. Belt must be stopped. Max speed 0 — belt won't move, max incline 0 — incline disabled.
phrases.Чем меньше шаг, тем точнее дека повторяе: The smaller the step, the more precisely the deck follows the incline from Zwift and routes. The button writes “Max incline” to the board and starts auto-calibration (~30 s, belt stopped).
phrases.Заводское 0,6. Плата останавливается ран: Factory 0.6. The board stops early when lowering and ignores small descents: the descent is sent this much lower and released when the deck arrives (by sensor). Works with a step below 1.0.
phrases.По нему прошивка понимает, что дека доех: Used by the firmware to know the deck reached 0 after stopping. “Auto”: sensor [ZT] if the board answers it, otherwise feedback [SETINC].
phrases.Для PSA15H — [ZT]. Если у другой платы к: For PSA15H — [ZT]. If another board uses a different command, enter it; empty = don't poll.
phrases.Что прошивка сейчас считает положением —: What the firmware currently takes as the position — from the selected source.
phrases.Лента должна ехать. Ползунок двигается с: The belt must be moving. The slider moves in the selected incline step and sets the incline immediately; watch “Real incline (sensor)” above.
phrases.Плата сама опускает деку до упора, потом: The board lowers the deck fully, then raises it to the top and stores the potentiometer readings (~30 s). After that 0 is 0 and max is max. Belt stopped, step off it.
phrases.Рабочая настройка: по этим шаблонам прош: Working setting: the firmware constantly sends speed and incline to the motor using these templates. Change only if your board understands other commands (find out in the “Command discovery” tab).
%03d — a 3-digit number with leading zeros. Scale: ×10 — 4.3 → 43, ×1 — 4.3 → 4, ×100 — 4.3 → 430.
phrases.PSA15H-0200 работает на 4800. Меняется с: PSA15H-0200 runs at 4800. Applies immediately without reboot; after an ESP reboot it's 4800 again. If the board stops answering, set 4800 back.
phrases.Разведка: команды уходят как есть и не м: Exploration: commands are sent as is and don't change firmware settings. Belt stopped or at most 2 km/h, hand on the power switch. If the deck or motor reacts — switch off and note the command.
phrases.Команды — по одной в строке, как есть: Commands — one per line, as is
phrases.Лента должна идти: команда 15 с уходит в: The belt must be moving: for 15 s the command replaces the normal incline command, then everything returns. This is how a format is tested before entering it in “Command format”.
phrases.Пока прослушка включена, ESP ничего не о: While the sniffer is on, the ESP sends nothing to the board — the stock onboard computer (the top panel with display and buttons) drives the treadmill. Wiring: onboard computer → stock board as from the factory; tap to our board only 12V, GND and the “onboard computer → board” line to our RX (don't connect our TX). Repeats collapse into ×N. The sniffer is off after a reboot.
phrases.Лента должна идти (малая скорость). Кноп: The belt must be moving (low speed). The step button sets 1.0 → 3.0 → 3.0 + step with 8 s pauses; watch only the last step — did the deck move. “Tenths test”: 3.0 → 4.3 → 5.0 — did the deck move at 5.0? If yes — the motor understands integers only; if not — tenths work, but a step ≥ the found one is needed.
